description: This file defines various enumerations for user preferences in an Android application, including layout, theme, color scheme, sorting, backup, deletion timing, date/time formats, media opening options, font size, UI modes, cloud services, sync settings, and security options.

classes.name: LayoutMode
classes.description: Enumeration for layout modes (Grid or List) with associated resource IDs.

classes.name: ThemeMode
classes.description: Enumeration for theme modes (System, Dark, Light) with resource IDs and mode constants.

classes.name: DarkThemeMode
classes.description: Enumeration for dark theme styles (Standard, Black) with resource IDs.

classes.name: ColorScheme
classes.description: Enumeration for color schemes with resource IDs and support requirement for system version.

classes.name: SortMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for sorting methods (by title, creation, modification) with resource IDs.

classes.name: SortTagsMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for tag sorting methods similar to SortMethod.

classes.name: SortNavdrawerNotebooksMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for sorting notebooks in navigation drawer.

classes.name: BackupStrategy
classes.description: Enumeration for backup strategies (include files, keep info, keep nothing).

classes.name: NoteDeletionTime
classes.description: Enumeration for note deletion timing with intervals in seconds and a method to convert to days.

classes.name: DateFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for date format patterns with resource IDs.

classes.name: TimeFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for time format patterns with resource IDs.

classes.name: OpenMediaIn
classes.description: Enumeration for media opening location (internal or external).

classes.name: ShowDate
classes.description: Enumeration for showing date (yes or no).

classes.name: FontSize
classes.description: Enumeration for font sizes with resource IDs and size values.

classes.name: ShowFabChangeMode
classes.description: Enumeration for FAB change modes (FAB or Topbar).

classes.name: GroupNotesWithoutNotebook
classes.description: Enumeration for grouping notes without a notebook (yes or no).

classes.name: MoveCheckedItems
classes.description: Enumeration for moving checked items (yes or no).

classes.name: DefaultEditorMode
classes.description: Enumeration for default editor mode (view or edit).

classes.name: CloudService
classes.description: Enumeration for cloud storage options (disabled, nextcloud, file storage).

classes.name: SyncMode
classes.description: Enumeration for sync modes (Wi-Fi or always).

classes.name: BackgroundSync
classes.description: Enumeration for background sync (enabled or disabled).

classes.name: NewNotesSyncable
classes.description: Enumeration for whether new notes are syncable (yes or no).

classes.name: TrustSelfSignedCertificate
classes.description: Enumeration for trusting self-signed certificates (no or yes).

methods.name: toDays
methods.description: Converts note deletion interval from seconds to days, handling special case for -1 (never).
